title: Select a completed ad hoc story from its Git directory capture

intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-293#select-completed-ad-hoc-story-from-git-directory

**Outcome: Caught.**

- **Story and revision:** `.planning/seeds/SEED-293-select-completed-ad-hoc-story-from-git-directory.md#select-completed-ad-hoc-story-from-git-directory` at `87684341a5c788fd8782467171ca46a42ab6a0f4`.
- **Promise:** A retained completed ad hoc session whose landing names the same repository's common `.git` directory selects its uniquely evidenced Done story.
- **Fault:** In `dashboard/server/completedStoryAssociation.ts`, replaced the common-Git-directory comparison with the previous direct `realpath(landing.repository) !== realpath(directory)` comparison. Fixture and assertion stayed unchanged.
- **Existing protection:** `dashboard/tests/sessions/recently-done-sessions-select-ad-hoc.spec.ts` supplies `landing.repository: path.join(origin.project, ".git")` at line 42. After clicking the retained row, line 130 asserts the public response equals `{kind:"linked", identity:linked.identity}`; later assertions check selected Intent and preserved Ad hoc provenance.
- **Observed path:** Passing baseline selected exactly one test (12.3 s). With the fault, that same test reached line 130 and failed with expected `linked` / `SEED-A#a`, received `absent`. After automatic restoration, `cmp` and `git diff --exit-code` confirmed original bytes and clean tracked state; the identical test passed again (6.9 s). This confirms the intended association behavior changed and the maintained assertion caught it.
- **Isolation and restoration:** Used the owned detached scratch worktree `/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-293-NxhT8P`, created at the exact revision, with its own `npm ci --ignore-scripts` installation. Restored source through an exit trap, verified a clean scratch checkout after the restored pass, and safely removed that worktree. No execution checkout, live session record or real Pygardon repository was changed.
- **Command for all three observations:** `caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard -- dashboard/tests/sessions/recently-done-sessions-select-ad-hoc.spec.ts --workers=1 --reporter=line`.

Costs:

- **Test runtime:** Measured runner-reported baseline 12.3 s and restored pass 6.9 s (19.2 s combined). The fault run's line reporter printed the failing test and assertion but no aggregate duration, so its runtime is unavailable.
- **Human effort:** Unavailable; no separate human-time measurement was supplied.
- **Agent effort:** Unavailable; the host exposed no independent agent-effort measure.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 164170 ms (measured), from 1794293211000 to 1794293375170 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
